findings.summary: Rejected candidate 9272617d51e6f2f4a663249e2d3b624871c204ac could execute retirement before independent review and merge. The accepted candidate requires an exact independent-pass receipt and evidence on fetched main, candidate/main/cleanup equality for every reviewed lifecycle surface, candidate ancestry in the exact cleanup branch, and equality between the executing lifecycle script blob and the reviewed main blob. Pre-review and unmerged-script refusal tests pass.

Rejected candidate 9272617d51e6f2f4a663249e2d3b624871c204ac cleared a present-side recovery journal after checking only filesystem and Git-list presence. The accepted candidate re-proves canonical managed and reparse-safe path, repository identity, target branch, live/local/expected HEAD, pristine tracked/untracked/ignored state, and absence of nested worktrees before clearing. Detached, switched, moved-HEAD, residue, reparse, nested, and replaced-path tests preserve the exact journal and refuse.

Rejected candidate 9272617d51e6f2f4a663249e2d3b624871c204ac did not bind registry_previous_head to the pending before-record. The accepted candidate requires exact equality with before_record.head and additionally binds package, source task, branch, and path; malformed journal recovery refuses without mutation.
